content.text: Enter Antipholus of Ephesus with an Officer.

lines.text: Fear me not, man, I will not break away:
lines.plainText: Fear me not man I will not break away

lines.text: I'll give thee ere I leave thee so much money,
lines.plainText: I'll give thee ere I leave thee so much money

lines.text: To warrant thee, as I am 'rested for.
lines.plainText: To warrant thee as I am 'rested for

lines.text: My wife is in a wayward mood today,
lines.plainText: My wife is in a wayward mood today

lines.text: And will not lightly trust the messenger
lines.plainText: And will not lightly trust the messenger

lines.text: That I should be attach'd in Ephesus;
lines.plainText: That I should be attach'd in Ephesus

lines.text: I tell you 'twill sound harshly in her ears.
lines.plainText: I tell you 'twill sound harshly in her ears

content.text: Enter Dromio of Ephesus with a rope's end.

lines.text: Here's that, I warrant you, will pay them all.
lines.plainText: Here's that I warrant you will pay them all

lines.text: But where's the money?
lines.plainText: But where's the money

lines.text: Why, sir, I gave the money for the rope.
lines.plainText: Why sir I gave the money for the rope

lines.text: Five hundred ducats, villain, for a rope?
lines.plainText: Five hundred ducats villain for a rope

lines.text: I'll serve you, sir, five hundred at the rate.
lines.plainText: I'll serve you sir five hundred at the rate

lines.text: To what end did I bid thee hie thee home?
lines.plainText: To what end did I bid thee hie thee home

lines.text: To a rope's end, sir; and to that end am I return'd.
lines.plainText: To a rope's end sir and to that end am I return'd

lines.text: And to that end, sir, I will welcome you.
lines.plainText: And to that end sir I will welcome you

lines.text: Good sir, be patient.
lines.plainText: Good sir be patient

lines.text: Nay, 'tis for me to be patient. I am in adversity.
lines.plainText: Nay 'tis for me to be patient I am in adversity

lines.text: Good now, hold thy tongue.
lines.plainText: Good now hold thy tongue

lines.text: Nay, rather persuade him to hold his hands.
lines.plainText: Nay rather persuade him to hold his hands

lines.text: Thou whoreson, senseless villain.
lines.plainText: Thou whoreson senseless villain

lines.text: I would I were senseless, sir, that I might not feel your blows.
lines.plainText: I would I were senseless sir that I might not feel your blows

lines.text: Thou art sensible in nothing but blows, and so is an ass.
lines.plainText: Thou art sensible in nothing but blows and so is an ass

lines.text: I am an ass indeed; you may prove it by my long ears. I have served him from the hour of my nativity to this instant, and have nothing at his hands for my service but blows. When I am cold, he heats me with beating; when I am warm he cools me with beating. I am waked with it when I sleep, raised with it when I sit, driven out of doors with it when I go from home, welcomed home with it when I return. Nay, I bear it on my shoulders as a beggar wont her brat; and I think when he hath lamed me, I shall beg with it from door to door.
lines.plainText: I am an ass indeed you may prove it by my long ears I have served him from the hour of my nativity to this instant and have nothing at his hands for my service but blows When I am cold he heats me with beating when I am warm he cools me with beating I am waked with it when I sleep raised with it when I sit driven out of doors with it when I go from home welcomed home with it when I return Nay I bear it on my shoulders as a beggar wont her brat and I think when he hath lamed me I shall beg with it from door to door

content.text: Enter Adriana, Luciana, Courtesan and a Schoolmaster called Pinch.

lines.text: Come, go along, my wife is coming yonder.
lines.plainText: Come go along my wife is coming yonder

lines.text: Mistress, respice finem, respect your end, or rather, the prophesy like the parrot, "Beware the rope's end."
lines.plainText: Mistress respice finem respect your end or rather the prophesy like the parrot Beware the rope's end

lines.text: Wilt thou still talk?
lines.plainText: Wilt thou still talk

lines.text: How say you now? Is not your husband mad?
lines.plainText: How say you now Is not your husband mad

lines.text: His incivility confirms no less.
lines.plainText: His incivility confirms no less

lines.text: Good Doctor Pinch, you are a conjurer;
lines.plainText: Good Doctor Pinch you are a conjurer

lines.text: Establish him in his true sense again,
lines.plainText: Establish him in his true sense again

lines.text: And I will please you what you will demand.
lines.plainText: And I will please you what you will demand

lines.text: Alas, how fiery and how sharp he looks!
lines.plainText: Alas how fiery and how sharp he looks

lines.text: Mark how he trembles in his ecstasy.
lines.plainText: Mark how he trembles in his ecstasy

lines.text: Give me your hand, and let me feel your pulse.
lines.plainText: Give me your hand and let me feel your pulse

lines.text: There is my hand, and let it feel your ear.
lines.plainText: There is my hand and let it feel your ear

lines.text: I charge thee, Satan, hous'd within this man,
lines.plainText: I charge thee Satan hous'd within this man

lines.text: To yield possession to my holy prayers,
lines.plainText: To yield possession to my holy prayers

lines.text: And to thy state of darkness hie thee straight.
lines.plainText: And to thy state of darkness hie thee straight

lines.text: I conjure thee by all the saints in heaven.
lines.plainText: I conjure thee by all the saints in heaven

lines.text: Peace, doting wizard, peace; I am not mad.
lines.plainText: Peace doting wizard peace I am not mad

lines.text: O, that thou wert not, poor distressed soul!
lines.plainText: O that thou wert not poor distressed soul

lines.text: You minion, you, are these your customers?
lines.plainText: You minion you are these your customers

lines.text: Did this companion with the saffron face
lines.plainText: Did this companion with the saffron face

lines.text: Revel and feast it at my house today,
lines.plainText: Revel and feast it at my house today

lines.text: Whilst upon me the guilty doors were shut,
lines.plainText: Whilst upon me the guilty doors were shut

lines.text: And I denied to enter in my house?
lines.plainText: And I denied to enter in my house

lines.text: O husband, God doth know you din'd at home,
lines.plainText: O husband God doth know you din'd at home

lines.text: Where would you had remain'd until this time,
lines.plainText: Where would you had remain'd until this time

lines.text: Free from these slanders and this open shame.
lines.plainText: Free from these slanders and this open shame

lines.text: Din'd at home? Thou villain, what sayest thou?
lines.plainText: Din'd at home Thou villain what sayest thou

lines.text: Sir, sooth to say, you did not dine at home.
lines.plainText: Sir sooth to say you did not dine at home

lines.text: Were not my doors lock'd up and I shut out?
lines.plainText: Were not my doors lock'd up and I shut out

lines.text: Perdy, your doors were lock'd, and you shut out.
lines.plainText: Perdy your doors were lock'd and you shut out

lines.text: And did not she herself revile me there?
lines.plainText: And did not she herself revile me there

lines.text: Sans fable, she herself revil'd you there.
lines.plainText: Sans fable she herself revil'd you there

lines.text: Did not her kitchen-maid rail, taunt, and scorn me?
lines.plainText: Did not her kitchenmaid rail taunt and scorn me

lines.text: Certes, she did, the kitchen-vestal scorn'd you.
lines.plainText: Certes she did the kitchenvestal scorn'd you

lines.text: And did not I in rage depart from thence?
lines.plainText: And did not I in rage depart from thence

lines.text: In verity, you did; my bones bear witness,
lines.plainText: In verity you did my bones bear witness

lines.text: That since have felt the vigour of his rage.
lines.plainText: That since have felt the vigour of his rage

lines.text: Is't good to soothe him in these contraries?
lines.plainText: Is't good to soothe him in these contraries

lines.text: It is no shame; the fellow finds his vein,
lines.plainText: It is no shame the fellow finds his vein

lines.text: And yielding to him, humours well his frenzy.
lines.plainText: And yielding to him humours well his frenzy

lines.text: Thou hast suborn'd the goldsmith to arrest me.
lines.plainText: Thou hast suborn'd the goldsmith to arrest me

lines.text: Alas! I sent you money to redeem you
lines.plainText: Alas I sent you money to redeem you

lines.text: By Dromio here, who came in haste for it.
lines.plainText: By Dromio here who came in haste for it

lines.text: Money by me? Heart and goodwill you might,
lines.plainText: Money by me Heart and goodwill you might

lines.text: But surely, master, not a rag of money.
lines.plainText: But surely master not a rag of money

lines.text: Went'st not thou to her for a purse of ducats?
lines.plainText: Went'st not thou to her for a purse of ducats

lines.text: He came to me, and I deliver'd it.
lines.plainText: He came to me and I deliver'd it

lines.text: And I am witness with her that she did.
lines.plainText: And I am witness with her that she did

lines.text: God and the rope-maker bear me witness
lines.plainText: God and the ropemaker bear me witness

lines.text: That I was sent for nothing but a rope.
lines.plainText: That I was sent for nothing but a rope

lines.text: Mistress, both man and master is possess'd,
lines.plainText: Mistress both man and master is possess'd

lines.text: I know it by their pale and deadly looks.
lines.plainText: I know it by their pale and deadly looks

lines.text: They must be bound and laid in some dark room.
lines.plainText: They must be bound and laid in some dark room

lines.text: Say, wherefore didst thou lock me forth today,
lines.plainText: Say wherefore didst thou lock me forth today

lines.text: And why dost thou deny the bag of gold?
lines.plainText: And why dost thou deny the bag of gold

lines.text: I did not, gentle husband, lock thee forth.
lines.plainText: I did not gentle husband lock thee forth

lines.text: And gentle master, I receiv'd no gold;
lines.plainText: And gentle master I receiv'd no gold

lines.text: But I confess, sir, that we were lock'd out.
lines.plainText: But I confess sir that we were lock'd out

lines.text: Dissembling villain, thou speak'st false in both.
lines.plainText: Dissembling villain thou speak'st false in both

lines.text: Dissembling harlot, thou art false in all,
lines.plainText: Dissembling harlot thou art false in all

lines.text: And art confederate with a damned pack
lines.plainText: And art confederate with a damned pack

lines.text: To make a loathsome abject scorn of me.
lines.plainText: To make a loathsome abject scorn of me

lines.text: But with these nails I'll pluck out these false eyes
lines.plainText: But with these nails I'll pluck out these false eyes

lines.text: That would behold in me this shameful sport.
lines.plainText: That would behold in me this shameful sport

content.text: [Enter three or four, and offer to bind him. He strives. ]

lines.text: O, bind him, bind him; let him not come near me.
lines.plainText: O bind him bind him let him not come near me

lines.text: More company; the fiend is strong within him.
lines.plainText: More company the fiend is strong within him

lines.text: Ay me, poor man, how pale and wan he looks!
lines.plainText: Ay me poor man how pale and wan he looks

lines.text: What, will you murder me? Thou jailer, thou,
lines.plainText: What will you murder me Thou jailer thou

lines.text: I am thy prisoner. Wilt thou suffer them
lines.plainText: I am thy prisoner Wilt thou suffer them

lines.text: To make a rescue?
lines.plainText: To make a rescue

lines.text: Masters, let him go.
lines.plainText: Masters let him go

lines.text: He is my prisoner, and you shall not have him.
lines.plainText: He is my prisoner and you shall not have him

lines.text: Go, bind this man, for he is frantic too.
lines.plainText: Go bind this man for he is frantic too

lines.text: What wilt thou do, thou peevish officer?
lines.plainText: What wilt thou do thou peevish officer

lines.text: Hast thou delight to see a wretched man
lines.plainText: Hast thou delight to see a wretched man

lines.text: Do outrage and displeasure to himself?
lines.plainText: Do outrage and displeasure to himself

lines.text: He is my prisoner. If I let him go,
lines.plainText: He is my prisoner If I let him go

lines.text: The debt he owes will be requir'd of me.
lines.plainText: The debt he owes will be requir'd of me

lines.text: I will discharge thee ere I go from thee;
lines.plainText: I will discharge thee ere I go from thee

lines.text: Bear me forthwith unto his creditor,
lines.plainText: Bear me forthwith unto his creditor

lines.text: And knowing how the debt grows, I will pay it.
lines.plainText: And knowing how the debt grows I will pay it

lines.text: Good master doctor, see him safe convey'd
lines.plainText: Good master doctor see him safe convey'd

lines.text: Home to my house. O most unhappy day!
lines.plainText: Home to my house O most unhappy day

lines.text: O most unhappy strumpet!
lines.plainText: O most unhappy strumpet

lines.text: Master, I am here enter'd in bond for you.
lines.plainText: Master I am here enter'd in bond for you

lines.text: Out on thee, villain! wherefore dost thou mad me?
lines.plainText: Out on thee villain wherefore dost thou mad me

lines.text: Will you be bound for nothing? Be mad, good master; cry, "the devil".
lines.plainText: Will you be bound for nothing Be mad good master cry the devil

lines.text: God help, poor souls, how idly do they talk!
lines.plainText: God help poor souls how idly do they talk

lines.text: Go bear him hence. Sister, go you with me.
lines.plainText: Go bear him hence Sister go you with me

content.text: [Exeunt Pinch and Assistants, with Antipholus of Ephesus and Dromio of Ephesus.]

lines.text: One Angelo, a goldsmith; do you know him?
lines.plainText: One Angelo a goldsmith do you know him

lines.text: I know the man. What is the sum he owes?
lines.plainText: I know the man What is the sum he owes

lines.text: Two hundred ducats.
lines.plainText: Two hundred ducats

lines.text: Say, how grows it due?
lines.plainText: Say how grows it due

lines.text: Due for a chain your husband had of him.
lines.plainText: Due for a chain your husband had of him

lines.text: He did bespeak a chain for me, but had it not.
lines.plainText: He did bespeak a chain for me but had it not

lines.text: When as your husband, all in rage, today
lines.plainText: When as your husband all in rage today

lines.text: Came to my house and took away my ring,
lines.plainText: Came to my house and took away my ring

lines.text: The ring I saw upon his finger now,
lines.plainText: The ring I saw upon his finger now

lines.text: Straight after did I meet him with a chain.
lines.plainText: Straight after did I meet him with a chain

lines.text: It may be so, but I did never see it.
lines.plainText: It may be so but I did never see it

lines.text: Come, jailer, bring me where the goldsmith is,
lines.plainText: Come jailer bring me where the goldsmith is

lines.text: I long to know the truth hereof at large.
lines.plainText: I long to know the truth hereof at large

content.text: Enter Antipholus of Syracuse with his rapier drawn, and Dromio of Syracuse.

lines.text: God, for thy mercy, they are loose again!
lines.plainText: God for thy mercy they are loose again

lines.text: And come with naked swords. Let's call more help
lines.plainText: And come with naked swords Let's call more help

lines.text: To have them bound again.
lines.plainText: To have them bound again

lines.text: Away, they'll kill us.
lines.plainText: Away they'll kill us

content.text: [Exeunt, as fast as may be, frighted.]

lines.text: I see these witches are afraid of swords.
lines.plainText: I see these witches are afraid of swords

lines.text: She that would be your wife now ran from you.
lines.plainText: She that would be your wife now ran from you

lines.text: Come to the Centaur, fetch our stuff from thence.
lines.plainText: Come to the Centaur fetch our stuff from thence

lines.text: I long that we were safe and sound aboard.
lines.plainText: I long that we were safe and sound aboard

lines.text: Faith, stay here this night, they will surely do us no harm; you saw they speak us fair, give us gold. Methinks they are such a gentle nation that, but for the mountain of mad flesh that claims marriage of me, I could find in my heart to stay here still and turn witch.
lines.plainText: Faith stay here this night they will surely do us no harm you saw they speak us fair give us gold Methinks they are such a gentle nation that but for the mountain of mad flesh that claims marriage of me I could find in my heart to stay here still and turn witch

lines.text: I will not stay tonight for all the town;
lines.plainText: I will not stay tonight for all the town

lines.text: Therefore away, to get our stuff aboard.
